slot.brief: Long solenoid with given turns per unit length and current; find the magnetic field at the centre or the field if an iron core of given relative permeability is inserted.

stem: A long air-core solenoid has $1000$ turns per metre and carries a current of $4$ A. Find the magnetic field at its centre. Take $\mu_0=4\pi\times10^{-7}\ \text{T m A}^{-1}$.
working:
$B=\mu_0 nI=(4\pi\times10^{-7})(1000)(4)=1.6\pi\times10^{-3}\ \text{T}$

Independent check: For a long air-core solenoid, $B=\mu_0 nI=(4\pi\times10^{-7})(1000)(4)=1.6\pi\times10^{-3}\,\text{T}$.
solution:
For a long air-core solenoid, $B=\mu_0 nI$.
$$B=(4\pi\times10^{-7})(1000)(4)=1.6\pi\times10^{-3}\ \text{T}$$
